## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what this changes and why. Include a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the relevant commands you ran and their results. State any game-resource,
platform or manual-playtest limitations; passing model tests is not a playthrough.

## Compatibility

If applicable, explain effects on existing player files, AP identities, settings
or saves. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/RAjeux/OOT-Remake-Archipelago/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the stable-ID and generated
file rules. Ordinary contributions do not bump VERSION or rewrite a published
release reference.

Include source changes and synthetic fixtures only, without game files, keys,
personal profiles, room credentials or user saves.
